verdict.rationale: Alloy documents signed webhooks: it signs the request body with a shared secret and sends the signature in the Authorization header, which lets a developer verify authenticity and integrity. It also documents that failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for 24 hours, but nothing describes a unique event ID or idempotency key for deduplicating those retries. Missing for 10: documented event/delivery IDs or idempotency guidance for deduplicating retried notifications, signature-verification details (algorithm, replay/timestamp protection), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify alert-event authenticity and deduplicate retried notifications
